rows.grounds: compound: madhyā-aṅgula-agra (tip of middle finger) + ubhayoḥ (of both, genitive dual) + stana-sūtra-sama (equal to the breast-thread); internal sandhi ubhayoḥ + stana > ubhayostana
compound: tanu-sūtra-sama (equal to the body-thread/cord line)

items.question: What prescribed alignment must the tips of both middle fingers maintain relative to the body’s measuring thread?
premises: The tips of the middle fingers of both sides are taken as the reference points.
These tips must be equal in position to the breast-thread line.
They must also be equal in position to the body-thread line.
items.inference: Therefore, the tips of both middle fingers should be aligned with the breast-thread and body-thread measures.
uncertainties: The exact distinction between tanasūtra and stanasūtra in this context is not fully certain from the verse alone.
items.plain_english: The tips of both middle fingers should be level with the breast-thread and with the body-thread.
